capabilities: Register system-wide hotkeys for individual pop-out windows
Toggle a window's visibility from any application
Slide a window in from a screen edge in Quake mode
Configure per-window hotkeys, edges, size, and animation
Expose toggle, move, and reset commands per window
extras: Windows only, desktop, Obsidian 1.13.1+; works in only one vault per computer; relies on undocumented Obsidian internals, so future updates may break it; no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian pop-out windows can only be reached from inside the app, so you cannot summon one with a keystroke while working in another program.

relations.evidence: Tray keeps handling the main window; Hideaway only handles its own windows.

summary: Gives Obsidian pop-out windows their own system-wide hotkeys, with optional Quake-style slide-in from a screen edge (Windows only).
